title: Rule sheet
summary: Fourteen pages that draw every rule of a value, a block and a layout on your own record, so a check can read each rule where a person sees it.
changes: A project's page now reads that project's own next step, how many domains and repositories it holds and the day it aims for, and Values shows one day as it reads in two zones.
author: BrainDog

blocks.heading: Values in text
blocks.body:
Each line below names one rule of a value written in text, then shows the value itself, so a reader can check the two agree.

## Values read from the record

A figure by its name: {{open-tasks}} tasks are open.

How far that figure moved: {{open-tasks.change}}.

The first task that figure counts: {{open-tasks.first}}.

How many tasks the record holds, a count and never the tasks themselves: {{tasks.count}}. How many of them are open: {{tasks.open}}.

A field of one task, named by its list and number: {{tasks#1.what}}.

A long field is never pulled into text, so the notes of that task show a dash: {{tasks#1.note}}.

A name that points at nothing is shown as written, marked: {{no-such-figure}}.

A value inside backticks is left exactly as typed: `{{open-tasks}}`.

## Typed values

A day ahead, with how far off it is: {{date:2030-12-24}}.

A day behind, with no link: {{day:2020-04-10}}.

The time left to a day: {{until:2030-01-01}}. The time left to the first task's due day: {{until:tasks#1.by}}.

The time since a day: {{ago:2020-01-01}}.

Money in minor units with its currency: {{money:129900 EGP}}. Money below nought: {{money:-4200 GBP}}.

A currency with four decimals: {{money:1000000 CLF}} and {{money:123456 UYW}}.

An amount longer than sixteen digits keeps every digit: {{money:900719925474099312 JPY}}.

A number with its unit: {{quantity:1.4 m}}. A quantity below nought: {{quantity:-2.5 kg}}. A whole number below nought: {{quantity:-1299}}.

A percentage: {{pct:-46.3}}. A percentage written loosely stays as typed, marked: {{pct:12 %}}.

A task named by reference: {{ref:tasks#1}}.

A typed value that does not parse stays as typed, marked: {{money:12.50 GBP}} and {{date:2026-13-45}}.

## Icons and evidence

An icon set inside a sentence: {{icon:rocket}} launched.

Checked once against a source: {verified} and {verified: the bank statement}.

Worked out from other facts: {inferred} and {inferred: two invoices}.

A careful guess: {estimate} and {estimate: last quarter's pace}.

Not known yet, something to find out: {unknown} and {unknown: nobody has asked}.

blocks.heading: A day in two zones
blocks.body: A day is counted from the reader's own today, never from Greenwich time. At half past ten at night Greenwich time on 14 October it is already the 15th in Cairo, so at that moment the day below is today in Cairo and still a day off in Greenwich time: {{day:2026-10-15}}.

blocks.heading: Blocks in text
blocks.body:
Each block below is written to test one rule of how a block is drawn. A block written wrongly is still shown, as the text that was typed with a line saying what is wrong.

## A stat takes six figures

```stat | Six figures
Open | 12 | in play
Late | 3 | past their day | bad
Done this week | 9 | five more than last week | good
Waiting on you | 2 | to check
With an agent | 4 | taken today
Later | 21 | kept for later
```

```stat | Seven figures
Open | 12 | in play
Late | 3 | past their day | bad
Done this week | 9 | five more than last week | good
Waiting on you | 2 | to check
With an agent | 4 | taken today
Later | 21 | kept for later
Dropped | 5 | let go this month
```

## Chips need a number and a word

```chips | Chips
rocket | 4 | launched
zap |  | shipped
star | 7 | 
check | 3 | done
```

## A bar with no number draws no bar

```bar | Hours by project
Kiln | 12 | this week
Portage | 7 | this week
Someday | not measured yet | no figure to draw
```

## Tone words a colour name stands for

```chips | Tone aliases
check | 1 | written earn | earn
x | 2 | written danger | danger
info | 3 | written accent | accent
alert | 4 | written risk | risk
```

## A block inside a note ends the note

```note | A note
This note opens here.
```stat | Inside the note
Open | 12 | in play
```

This line is outside the note: the first closing marks after the note opened ended it, and a block cannot sit inside another.

## A ring takes five parts

```ring | Five parts
Rent | 600 | a month
Food | 300 | a month
Travel | 120 | a month
Phone | 40 | a month
Books | 30 | a month
```

```ring | Six parts
Rent | 600 | a month
Food | 300 | a month
Travel | 120 | a month
Phone | 40 | a month
Books | 30 | a month
Gifts | 20 | a month
```
